title: Figures 77-78: CFD pressure and temperature around Tic Tac UAP at 500 mph
description: Two CFD contour plots for the Tic Tac UAP at 1/6 scale, 223K air temperature and 500 mph with mixed inlet and subsonic outlet. Figure 77 maps pressure (Pa) with stagnation heating at the nose; Figure 78 maps temperature (K) showing an extended warm wake. Intermediate-speed case of the BAASS Tic Tac CFD study.
